+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "text,lemma,entry,scope",
+    [
+        ("You want something.", "want", "wordnet:want:desire.v.01", "EXPLICIT_NATIVE_ALIGNMENT"),
+        ("She thinks about something.", "think", "nsm_chart:v20:think", "PRIMARY_UNIT_ONLY"),
+        ("You know.", "know", "wordnet:know:know.v.01", "EXPLICIT_NATIVE_ALIGNMENT"),
+        ("I see someone.", "see", "wordnet:see:see.v.01", "EXPLICIT_NATIVE_ALIGNMENT"),
+        ("She hears something.", "hear", "wordnet:hear:hear.v.01", "EXPLICIT_NATIVE_ALIGNMENT"),
+        ("You feel something.", "feel", "nsm_chart:v20:feel", "PRIMARY_UNIT_ONLY"),
+        ("He says something.", "say", "nsm_chart:v20:say", "PRIMARY_UNIT_ONLY"),
+        ("Something happens to me.", "happen", "wordnet:happen:happen.v.01", "EXPLICIT_NATIVE_ALIGNMENT"),
+        ("You move.", "move", "nsm_chart:v20:move", "PRIMARY_UNIT_ONLY"),
+        ("This is good.", "good", "nsm_chart:v20:good", "PRIMARY_UNIT_ONLY"),
+        ("That is bad.", "bad", "nsm_chart:v20:bad", "PRIMARY_UNIT_ONLY"),
+        ("Something big.", "big", "nsm_chart:v20:big", "PRIMARY_UNIT_ONLY"),
+        ("Something small.", "small", "nsm_chart:v20:small", "PRIMARY_UNIT_ONLY"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_complete_primary_frame_licenses_only_its_source_unit_and_admitted_partial_values(
+    encoder, text, lemma, entry, scope
+):
+    token = next(t for t in encoder.encode(text).tokens if t.lemma == lemma)
+    evidence = token.lexical_evidence
+    proof = evidence["contextual_grounding"]
+    assert proof["code"] == "PRIMARY_UNIT_FRAME" and proof["identity_scope"] == scope
+    assert evidence["selected_record"]["entry_id"] == entry
+    assert proof["unresolved_ordinary_entry_ids"]  # finer identities were NOT merged
+    assert proof["source_reference"]["sha256"] == "5847b39219381181f98a2afbfc57b149ad16cd77157ca0d205b341d1466cf732"
+    assert all(frame["source_record_ids"] and frame["role_witnesses"] for frame in proof["frames"])
+    selected = encoder.lookup_definition(entry)["selected"]
+    assert evidence["domains"] == selected["domains"]
+    assert token.word_primitives == {k: v for k, v in selected["assignments"].items() if v}
+    # Neither someone/something slots nor the lexical gaps become own-unit signs.
+    assert evidence["domains"]["TOUCH"] == [-1, 0, 1]
+    assert token.word_primitives.get("SOMEONE") != 1
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "text,lemma",
+    [
+        ("She feels the cloth.", "feel"),
+        ("They hear a case.", "hear"),
+        ("She feels good about this.", "feel"),
+        ("He moved the proposal.", "move"),
+        ("A good ten miles.", "good"),
+        ("Something wants someone.", "want"),
+        ("He wants something or someone.", "want"),
+        ("The rock knows.", "know"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_primary_frame_requires_whole_valency_and_independently_attested_roles(encoder, text, lemma):
+    token = next(t for t in encoder.encode(text).tokens if t.lemma == lemma)
+    assert token.lexical_evidence["selected_record"] is None
+    assert token.word_primitives == {}
+    assert token.lexical_evidence["contextual_grounding"]["code"] != "PRIMARY_UNIT_FRAME"
+
+
+def test_primary_unit_source_observation_must_match_complete_original_features(encoder, monkeypatch):
+    from GSE.symbolic import lexical_grounding
+
+    records = {k: dict(v) for k, v in lexical_grounding._primary_records().items()}
+    records["nsm_chart:v20:think"]["frame_text"] = "changed frame"
+    monkeypatch.setattr(lexical_grounding, "_primary_records", lambda: records)
+    token = next(t for t in encoder.encode("You think about something.").tokens if t.lemma == "think")
+    assert token.lexical_evidence["selected_record"] is None
+    assert token.word_primitives == {}
*** End Patch
